pages.text: $(bold)Mars: The Red Planet$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mars difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mars death}}$()$(br2)Mars is hostile and needs more preparation than the Moon. Its thin atmosphere gives no protection from the extreme cold.

$(bold)Environmental Hazards$()$(br)• $(bold)Cold damage$() ticks constantly without Frostward or cold protection$(br)• $(bold)Faster hunger drain$(): bring extra food or Golden Apples$(br)• Cold-themed mobs are adapted to the environment$(br2)Frostward is worth a lot here. Without it the cold damage never stops, and it adds up quickly.

$(bold)Purpose$()$(br)Mars has the ores and materials the $(bold)Tier 3 Rocket$() needs to reach Venus and Mercury, Cryogenic Crystals among them. The Martian ruins and underground facilities hold rare loot.$(br2)$(bold)Recommended Gear$()$(br)• Netherite Space Suit or MekaSuit$(br)• Frostward-enchanted armor$(br)• High-saturation food supply$(br)• Working RF power for oxygen production

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Mars Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Ferric Oxide$() (30%): heat-resistant compound$(br)• $(bold)Cryogenic Crystal$() (15%): cold-resistant tech$(br)• Redstone (40%)$(br2)The Thermal Pulverizer gives slightly better odds.

$(bold)Thermal Regulation Enchantment$()$(br)Mars mobs have a $(bold)12% chance$() to drop an enchanted book of $(bold)Thermal Regulation$() (max level 3). On armor, it:$(br)• Negates cold and heat damage from the environment, Glacio's extreme cold included$(br)• Cuts temperature damage by 33% per level$(br)• Fully negates Mars cold and Mercury cold at level 3$(br2)$(bold)Next: crush Mars Stone.$()
